name: low-capex-growth
notes: Titman et al. (2004) capex-acceleration proxy. delta_lt = (TA-CA change)/TA; capex_growth = (delta_lt - delta_lt.shift(252)) / |delta_lt.shift(252)|, clipped [-10,10]. 2nd derivative of LT asset change. Distinct from H263 (1st derivative level). Sector-neutral bottom 20%, monthly rebalance.
